<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# World model update:
# - Moving object = purple ring (circle outline, center M). Started (47,17).
# - It moves toward the gray diamond (G, ~center 59,27) by halving remaining distance per click.
# - It leaves a fading white plus-trail at its previous center.
# - Static purple ring at (21,39) = same shape as moving ring (likely the TARGET).
# - Diamond shrank 12->7 as ring approached (ring is "eating" it), now ring stuck at (57,25), clicks no-op.
# Hypotheses: (A) click sets target -> click static ring should pull moving ring there.
#             (B) diamond is food; eat it fully then ring goes to static ring.
# Probe: click the static ring center (21,39) and see if moving ring reacts.
r = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':21,'col':39}], intent='explore')
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','reward']})
# report moving ring center + diamond + static ring after
def Mpos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M': return n['boundary'][0]
def Gpx(f):
    s=0
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='G': s+=n['pixels']
    return s
print("M now:", Mpos(current_frame), " G px:", Gpx(current_frame))
